schedule_rules: next crop start minus previous crop end must be >=0.5 day
crop period end-start+1 must be >=0.5 day
active calendar uses start tolerance -0.1 day and end tolerance +0.1 day
during fallow ICROP already points to the next upcoming crop

composition.soil_state: preserved externally; rotation owner never copies or resets it

remaining: Bind parameter-set selection keyed by crop_key exactly once at season start.
Atomically retire prior crop owner and optional shadow, reset pre-emergence owner, and later initialize the next active crop owner.
Persist/restart the rotation cursor across fallow and season boundaries.
Qualify two crops separated by fallow, rejected boundary transition, replay and restart on both sides.
